changes.title: Incomplete table totals
changes.text: Item and enemy counts retain incomplete-data warnings when a framed event cannot be decoded; recorded values and raw history remain unchanged.

changes.title: Rebuild outdated derived rows

changes.text: Retain original-source failure controls, four permanent payload/cache cases and the complete combined core suite.

changes.title: Record exact regression scope and remaining checks
changes.text: Preserve concurrent collection and saved-layout corrections, local failures and corrected evidence, and pending Android/build/physical-device limitations.

changes.title: Verify TEST228 and preserve later core evidence
changes.text: Record exact core, APK, Android, screenshot and identity evidence for TEST228 while keeping the newer typed-payload source and its core-only acceptance explicitly separate.

changes.title: Keep public combat and heals when hidden details are malformed

commentary: TEST228 remains verified. The newer typed-payload and malformed-detail reliability changes now require exact before/after core evidence and one complete TEST229 application gate.
